proposals.evidence: DEDR 636 full article (p. 61) gives Kor. (O.) ubbi to spit; (T.) umi saliva. Te. umiyu to spit, spit out; ummi spittle, saliva. DED 547. Bhat ibbi “to spit” matches Lindgren Koraga ibbi “spit” in form and sense; this cross-source match is a candidate lead, with the full DEDR article defining the family. Both source identities and dialect tags are preserved.
